_how: One place for every number that exists only after the merge. Fill the "values" map (replace each "{{KEY}}" with the real value, e.g. "TESTS_PY": "6,512"); docs/evidence/make_evidence.py and docs/deck/make_deck.py both read it. A value left as its own {{KEY}} is printed as-is (highlighted) and listed on stderr when you build. make_evidence.py --fill-impact scripts/impact_results.json fills the IMPACT_* values from a Mumbai impact run.

values.REPLAY_RESULT: with the rain gauges' observed totals, the model flagged 9 of the 12 places reported flooded on its network (King's Circle, Andheri Subway, Gandhi Market, Byculla, Dadar TT, Vile Parle, Hindmata, Chembur, Kurla by the Mithi) and missed Sion, Khar and Goregaon. Its own flag came after the first news report at most places (median 51 minutes late: the bucket model fills slowly); with the observed rain as a perfect 2-hour nowcast (hindsight) it would have led the first report at 8 of the 9 (median 69 minutes). The Open-Meteo archive carried a third of the gauges' rain and flagged nothing, which is the case for a live rain-gauge feed. A second replay, 26 May 2025, flagged 5 of 15 reported places.
